note: Per-actor perspective depth factor for the Scooby-Doo Mystery Godot port. CORRECTED 2026-07-31 (execution-grounded re-investigation): the ROM DOES derive a real per-actor depth factor ranging ~1.0 (front/near) to ~0.50 (back/far). This supersedes the earlier 'no scaling / scale=1.0 everywhere' conclusion, which contradicted the user's ground truth. The factor formula is VERIFIED and executed; whether the ROM applies it to sprite SIZE (vs only actor screen position, in the path traced) is the one open gap (see mechanism.open_gap) -- but since the user (ground truth) reports a visible SIZE change and the factor magnitude is ROM-derived, the port should apply this same factor as the actor sprite scale. Numbers here are DERIVED (formula + executed bounds), not hand-measured.

mechanism.bound_source: per-actor value from room floor-profile geometry interpolator 0x71CC (walks table via $FF0692; lobby floor-profile table at ROM 0x136564). Near/front -> bound~0 -> scale~1.0; far/back -> bound~128 -> scale~0.50.
mechanism.enable_gate: $FF09E8 bit3 (tested 0xB4F2/0xAF52/0xB12A); set at 0x4356 via script opcode-12 sub-command-21 (0x432C). In the captured standing-still lobby frame bit3=0 (ease idle); set during scripted walks/cutscenes such as the Blake intro (scripted_intro_walk_sequence 0x3F58).
mechanism.sprite_emit_cite: actor_sprite_oam_emit 0xAD16-0xAF22: OAM size word (0xAF14 <- ROM table $0FC9C0..) and per-piece x/y offsets ($0FC86C.., $0FC944..) are selected ONLY by frame descriptor type byte 4(A1) + flip bit 0xA(A1); the scaled value enters ONLY as the actor screen origin (screen = pos - scroll + hw_origin - hotspot, 0xAD5A-0xADAC). Genesis VDP cannot hardware-zoom sprites.
mechanism.executed_render_y_sweep: work/sweep_render_y.py: bumping an actor render-Y by 48px and re-emitting changed 0 sprite sizes -> emit path is position-only; a smaller on-screen actor requires either the perspective origin ease or a different (smaller) frame-set type byte selected by the anim/script.
mechanism.open_gap: Direct front-vs-back SIZE capture not achieved (driving a lobby walk destabilized the double-buffered gameplay loop). The 1.0->0.50 factor is verified+executed and traced into actor POSITION; the exact size consumer (discrete far-frame type-byte swap, or an unlocated size path) is INFERRED, not yet executed. NEXT STEP: drive the deterministic Blake intro 0x3F58 and dump the SAT per-frame to watch Blake's type byte / sprite height step down as $FF04E8 decreases.

verification.applies_to_size: INFERRED (user ground-truth + derived magnitude; direct capture pending)

port_apply.recommended: Apply scale(actor) = clamp((255 - bound(actor)) / 256, far_scale, 1.0), where bound is interpolated from the room's floor-profile. In flat/non-depth rooms bound=0 -> scale=1.0 automatically, so this is safe to apply globally and matches the ROM gating.
port_apply.curve: ramp on the room floor-profile (linear-ish similar-triangles interp at 0x71CC); exact Y->bound curve per room to be pinned from a driven capture.

hotel.16.formula: scale = (255 - bound)/256, bound from floor-profile geom 0x71CC (lobby table ROM 0x136564)
hotel.16.verified: user ground-truth (characters shrink toward back; Blake shrinks in intro) + executed real-lobby per-actor factors [1.0, 0.50, 0.75]
hotel.16.note: THE lobby the user names. near_y~150 (front floor), far_y~40 (back); exact Y->scale curve pending a driven-intro capture.

_other_rooms.policy: Every room runs the same 0x71CC/(255-bound)/256 machinery. A room with a flat floor-profile yields bound=0 -> scale=1.0 (no visible effect); a room with a receding floor yields <1.0 at the back. Rather than hardcode a false enabled:false (which repeats the disputed conclusion), the port should apply the ramp keyed on each room's floor-profile. Only the lobby's numbers are independently characterized here; other rooms' near/far bounds were not captured this pass.
_other_rooms.caveat: The absence of a literal op-12/sub-21 in a room's scene stream does NOT mean no depth: bit3 is also set transiently during scripted walks/cutscenes, and the geometry bounds are computed regardless. The prior pass over-read this absence as 'scale=1.0, disabled'.
